title: Retire and decompose project-local adapters
status_detail: explicitly activated by current human instruction for bounded R2.2 implementation; no successor activated
objective: Remove obsolete project-local adapters and assign each surviving Task, ownership, resource, or legacy-compatibility translation to its owned contract without introducing a generic adapter framework.
authorized_scope: Audit every live consumer and compatibility obligation of the nine public ActionObjects currently in `python/src/ksdft2effmass/harness/pi/local/adapters.py`: `TaskRecordAdapter`, `ChainRecordAdapter`, `CheckpointRecordAdapter`, `AgentRecordAdapter`, `OwnershipManifestAdapter`, `ChecksumCatalogAdapter`, `SkillInventoryAdapter`, `EvidenceOwnershipManifestAdapter`, and `EvidenceModuleSelector`.

For each adapter, record its public import path and execute signature, maintained documentation claim, internal Python callers, command or script callers, resource/profile/descriptor references, required archived input formats, whether it translates authoritative input or only generated projections, proposed disposition, and compatibility impact.

The verified planning baseline finds no maintained production-module instantiation of the nine adapters outside package exports; definitions, public exports, tests, maintained or historical documentation, and retained evidence remain references. This absence of an internal production caller is not by itself deletion authority because the adapters remain package-level public exports and `TaskRecordAdapter` is documented for external-command compatibility.

Assign each adapter exactly one disposition: retain as a supported public compatibility API; relocate under a cohesive Task, ownership, resource, evidence, or narrowly bounded legacy owner while preserving its supported import and signature; deprecate through an explicitly authorized compatibility change; or delete only after proving both that no supported external or command consumer and no required archived input depends on it.

Retire adapters that satisfy the deletion proof, adapters translating only between generated projections with no supported external obligation, and compatibility readers whose archived-input requirement is proven absent; do not count tests, retained evidence, or historical mentions as live production consumers, but preserve them as evidence of the prior contract where applicable.
Split surviving behavior by Task, ownership, resource, evidence, and narrowly bounded legacy-Markdown contracts when those owners remain necessary; do not introduce a generic adapter framework.

Keep R2.1 `dbcontrol` ownership separate: database-control ingestion may consume canonical domain objects or narrowly owned deserializers, but must not absorb `local/adapters.py` wholesale, duplicate an adapter layer, or make adapter survival necessary merely for architectural symmetry.

Preserve required historical traceability and every supported compatibility behavior, public import, and execute signature unless the adapter's explicit disposition authorizes its deprecation or removal.
completion_criteria: A reviewed nine-row disposition matrix records the required consumer, command, resource, archive, projection, ownership, and compatibility evidence for every adapter and distinguishes no internal caller from no supported consumer.

Every retained adapter has an identified supported consumer or compatibility obligation and one explicit owned contract; every relocated adapter preserves its authorized public behavior; every removed adapter has both external-consumer and archived-input non-use evidence.

Obsolete adapters and generated-projection-only translations with no supported compatibility obligation are removed, while `TaskRecordAdapter` or any other documented external compatibility surface remains until its contract is explicitly dispositioned.
No adapter behavior is hidden in `dbcontrol`, no generic adapter framework is created, and no reverse dependency from generic harness behavior to project-local state is introduced.

Focused adapter, public-import, external-command compatibility, and archive-fixture tests, the maintained harness software-verification suite, Ruff, mypy, documentation validation, and dependency-lock nonmutation checks pass.
The work package completes without activating its successor.
exclusions: Do not infer deletion authority solely from repository-source non-use, package-export presence, tests, reviewer agreement, or retained evidence; supported external contracts and required archived inputs need explicit dispositions.
Do not remove a compatibility reader without evidence that no live or required archived input consumes it.
Do not reopen the completed R2.1 `dbcontrol` decomposition or move database-control behavior back into adapters.
Do not rewrite or delete retained `.pi` history, exact human decisions, Tasks, chains, checkpoints, or evidence.
Do not implement R2.3 through R2.7, activate another work package, add dependencies, modify scientific/package-source modules, or perform protected or release actions.
